page_note: 该页为《Health at a Glance: Europe 2024》第43页，含正文与一张折线图 Figure 1.18，展示2012–2022年5个EU国家65岁及以上医生占比。

heading.title: The share of doctors aged 65 and over has increased over the past decade in several EU countries
heading.unit_text: Share of doctors aged 65 and over

components.evidence: no legend; "Italy", "Belgium", "France", "Slovak Republic", "Germany" printed at the right end of each line
the plot area is filled light grey while the page around it is white
pale horizontal rules run across the grey panel at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25
"Source: Eurostat (hlth_rs_phys)." in small print under the plot
"StatLink" glyph with "https://stat.link/k5rgpc" printed below the source line
axis ticks are bare 0-30; "Share of doctors aged 65 and over" is the only scale phrase
"Share of doctors aged 65 and over" sits above the top tick "30", left aligned

new_components.name: series_label_gutter_outside_plot
new_components.evidence: the five series names sit in a right-hand margin outside the grey panel, level with each line end
new_components.why_it_matters: 标签在绘图区之外的右侧留白列，读值时必须把标签水平投射回2022年端点，而不是在曲线旁就近取名。

new_components.name: empty_trailing_category_slot
new_components.evidence: a lone "." is printed on the x axis to the right of the "2022" tick label
new_components.why_it_matters: 轴上多出一个空类别位，使2022不是最右端点，按像素等分推年份会整体偏移一格。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，55个点全靠像素对轴读取；轴每5单位约57像素，即1单位≈11像素。对27这样的大值5%容差=1.35单位（约15像素）尚可，但被计分的4和7两个小值，5%仅0.2和0.35单位，合2–4像素，比线宽还窄，且Germany与Slovak Republic起点在同一区域，几乎无法稳定落在容差内。相比之下寻址只需“国家+年份”两个键，正文还直接写出Italy 27%，标签层面压力小得多。

suggestions.what_to_add: inline_series_labels 与新提出的 series_label_gutter_outside_plot（端点标签置于绘图区右侧留白）
suggestions.where_to_change: 折线图样式条件行中新增“图例位置=端点标签/右侧留白”，并在记录字段里保留 series 名与其端点年份的绑定
suggestions.new_ablation_row: “无图例、仅端点标签” vs “底部图例”下的系列-取值配对准确率对比行

suggestions.what_to_add: axis_title_above_axis 配合 unit_in_axis_or_title（“Share of doctors aged 65 and over”置于顶端刻度之上）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题/单位样式字段：单位文本位置枚举增加 above_top_tick，与 subtitle、rotated 轴标题并列
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位置于顶端刻度上方 vs 置于旋转轴标题时，导出表头能否带上单位的成功率行

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 empty_trailing_category_slot（2022右侧多出的“.”刻度位）
suggestions.where_to_change: 时间轴生成条件行：允许尾部存在空类别槽/占位刻度标签
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 轴末尾存在空槽时，年份↔取值对齐错位一格的发生率行

suggestions.what_to_add: dense_marks_100plus 的下探版本：5系列×11年=55个无标签点的密度控制
suggestions.where_to_change: 密度上限参数改为可控变量，并按“每单位轴长像素”给出可达精度
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 每单位11像素、无数值标签时，按数值量级（<5、5–15、>20）分层的5%命中率行
